correction: PR #265 believed a 0700 mode check on the config home proved MarkDone's directory mode. Reality: the test pre-created the config home with touch (0755), so the check passed only under a 077 umask and failed in CI (umask 022). The mode check now uses a fresh config home that only MarkDone creates, and the legacy autostart removal has its own test.
